datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2012 across Haiti. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) representing food insecurity conditions at four time points (January, April, July, October). The data represent post-event/current situation assessments of food security status rather than hazard or exposure measurements.
